scope_rationale: Actual corpus Money mechanism needs currency identity, exact minor-unit arithmetic, rounding policy and conservative composition beyond Q7 saturation. Existing historical project and hours are unchanged.

refinements.mechanism: currency-tagged exact money and transactional allocation
outcomes: State the exact currency/scale representation, runtime admission and the limits of C value-wrapper enforcement.
Derive correct signed rational rounding without overflowing an intermediate, including INT64_MIN and both tie parities.
Implement conservative largest-remainder allocation and staged settlement with explicit identity and failure invariants.
Falsify lost units and partial publication against independent exact oracles; assess cost and changed-condition transfer.

preservation: Additive required exercise; no claim that it replaces the existing Q7 or numerical objectives.
